description: Population Estimates and Projections, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). Estimates and projections of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population for 2006 to 2031 are published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). These includes both forward projections and backcast estimates (i.e., estimates of past population statistics) by sex and age group. The estimates are for Australia, States and Territories, Remoteness Areas and Indigenous Regions (IREG). Coverage is Australia, 2017 to 2031; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-12-14. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
